title.narrative: Joining Efforts: Supporting Vulnerable populations in the move towards 90-90-90 - Suriname (01-Jan-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Suriname, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health, Welfare and Labour (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections. Improve the quality of live of PLHIV. Reduce incidence, mortality and transmission of TB. The objectives of this program are: Reduce HIV transmission among key and vulnerable population groups (MSM, SW, Youth and others) and in the general population. Expand high quality comprehensive HIV treatment, care and support. Eliminate Mother-Child transmission. Detect 95% of expected sputum positive TB cases, cure 95% of these cases
